subject: <what is judged, in words that follow 'You are judging': a reply that a member of staff will send to a customer>
given: <what the writer was given, the judge's ground truth: the tool results the writer was given>

criteria.question: Is every claim and promise in the reply supported by the data the writer was given?
criteria.pass: everything it tells the customer is in that data or follows plainly from it
criteria.fail: it states or promises something that data doesn't support, such as a refund, a date or a cause, whether or not the sentence cites a passage

criteria.question: <One narrow question that two people reading the same text would answer the same way.>
criteria.pass: <what a text that passes does, in words that follow 'It passes when'>
criteria.fail: <what a text that fails does, in words that follow 'It fails when', naming the failures you have seen>
